title: Matswale Phase 12, Musina (map point estimated): liquor store owner, 37, shot dead in his store; no arrest, 16 Oct

story: Police say a 37-year-old businessman was shot dead inside his liquor store at Matswale Phase 12, Musina, at about 20:00 on Friday 16 October. His wife, who was at the scene, told police he was preparing to close when an unknown man came in, handed him a R200 note and asked to buy liquor, then allegedly opened fire while he fetched it from the fridge. He had more than 20 gunshot wounds to the upper body and was declared dead at the scene; about 23 spent cartridges were found (police spokesperson Capt Vuledzani Dathi, via Limpopo Mirror). Musina police opened a murder case. Police say the motive and the suspect's identity are unknown; no arrest has been reported. The victim is not named here. One public report, resting on police: Limpopo Mirror, 22 October. The map point is estimated: Matswale Phase 12 could not be placed on a map, so the pin is a Musina township reference point, not the store.
incident: Fri 16 Oct 2026, about 20:00 (police, via Limpopo Mirror)
location_note: ESTIMATED MAP POINT. Inside his liquor store at Matswale Phase 12, Musina (police, via Limpopo Mirror); no street or address given. Matswale Phase 12 was not found on a map (OpenStreetMap Overpass and Nominatim searches returned no Matswale feature). The pin is the Musina-Nancefield township point from the in-repo gazetteer (GeoNames), used only as a reference inside the Musina police precinct; it is not confirmed that Phase 12 lies in Nancefield. Uncertainty about 5 km. Not the store.
